title: お弁当つめつめ！ ～BENTO BOX～
tagline: おかずを回して、ぴったり詰める。箱は4×4から8×8へ。
coreMechanic: Rotate (no mirror) polyomino side dishes and pack them into a lacquer bento box with no gaps. The box grows 4x4 → 5x5 → 6x6 → 7x7 → 8x8, six bentos each (30); explicit next-bento confirm; box checkpoints
runSecondsDesignTarget: 10-25 min for all 30 bentos (design hypothesis, not measured); one box is a natural session

stages.5x5-8x8: 6 each, generated once from fixed seeds (size*1000 + j*37 + 11) by a tiling generator; dishes 4-6 (5x5), 4-7 (6x6), 5-8 (7x7), 6-8 (8x8) cells, within a 4x4 bounding box, at most 10 per bento; every stage solver-verified

inputs.drag: mouse/touch drag a tray dish, snaps to grid, green legal / red illegal preview, release to place; pointercancel never places
inputs.tap: tap a tray dish to select, tap a box cell: the dish covers that cell (first food cell preferred)
inputs.keyboard: 1-9 and 0 (10th) or Tab+Enter select; arrows move; R rotates; Enter/Space place; Esc deselect/pause; key repeat ignored
inputs.rotate: on-screen 44px button or R, selected unplaced dish only
inputs.remove: tap/drag/Enter on a placed dish returns it to the tray (counts as undo)
inputs.pause: button/Escape; blur/visibility hidden auto-pause; active drags released

practice: Isolated 4x4 IIOO board, repeatable, all inputs; never touches score/BEST/checkpoint
scoring: per bento max(0, 1000 - round(48*floor(sec)/cells + 80*rotations/dishes + 200*removals/dishes)); identical to rules v1 on 4x4 (3/s, 20/rotation, 50/removal); invalid drops free; run total 0..30000
save: rules2: web-mini-arcade:v1:game037:best:rules2 {best, cleared} updated after every production bento; web-mini-arcade:v1:game037:checkpoint:rules2 {sizeIndex, results} after each finished box, cleared on full completion; web-mini-arcade:v1:game037:mute. The rules1 BEST key is never read or written. Memory fallback when storage is refused
telemetry: none (no analytics/telemetry/network calls in this prototype)
art: hand-authored original SVG: bento box, 10 per-cell food motifs (foods.svg) composed at runtime onto rounded dish bases for any polyomino, noren, washi/wood tiles, seal, sparkle; no image generation; see docs/game037/ASSET_INDEX.md
